facts.fact: The Minister of State for ICT and National Guidance launched the Uganda National Data Strategy in Kampala on 20 October 2026, with a costed implementation plan of sh1.6 trillion over five years.
New Vision reports the strategy provides for a National Data Steering Committee chaired by the Finance ministry and a National Data Office within the ICT ministry to coordinate delivery.
